metadata.description: Industrial Camera & Lens Selection Database for NI Vision / Basler dart / C-mount & Macro optics

field_definitions.fov_h_mm: Horizontal Field of View in millimeters
field_definitions.fov_v_mm: Vertical Field of View in millimeters
field_definitions.mm_per_pixel: Spatial resolution (mm per pixel, lower is finer precision). Note: labelled Pixel/mm in original spreadsheet
field_definitions.pixels_per_mm: Pixel density (pixels per mm, higher means more sampling density)

macro_lenses.description: Direct magnification based optics where FOV = Sensor_Dimension / Magnification and mm/pixel = Pixel_Pitch / Magnification
